tagline: Chess on hexagons, with three bishops. Play the computer or a friend.
description:
Hexagonal chess. The computer thinks here on this device, or you send one link and a friend sits the other colour.

Ninety-one hexes, three colours, three bishops. Tap a piece, then a hex — legal hexes light up. White sits at the near side. Close the tab and the game is still there when you come back.

On your own, a computer looks a little way ahead right on the phone. Pass the device for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite.

There is no castling. A pawn that steps two hexes can still be taken in passing. This is the hexagonal kind, not the square board.
